author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN)
notes: Frontal studio cutout, neutral. Clearest view of the long oval face, lined-up hairline, short curly top with faded sides, almond eyes, broad nose, full lips, moustache and dense chin goatee. Studio grade is warm and saturated, so skin reads more orange than in arena photos.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN)
date_taken: unknown (newer kit with crypto.com logo, likely 2025)
notes: Full-body three-quarter cutout in red UFC compression-length shorts with white/maroon slash pattern. Physique (broad shoulders, big pecs, long arms), forearm tattoos, chest script.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN)
notes: Full-body near-frontal cutout, same red shorts with a Venum logo. Best view of the left-chest script, left-shoulder clock and roses, and the portrait tattoo low on his left abdomen.

author: Cageside Press (appears to be a still from the UFC London media-day video)
notes: Media day in a grey hoodie, slight three-quarter. Most recent clear face: same haircut and goatee; small marks on both cheeks.

author: Cageside Press
date_taken: 2026-03-20 (UFC London ceremonial face-off with Movsar Evloev)
notes: Near-profile of his left side at close range: fade line above the ear, sloping forehead, flat-to-medium nose bridge with rounded tip, lips projecting ahead of the chin, ear shape, left-shoulder clock tattoo.

author: Cageside Press
notes: High-res (1996 x 1324) weigh-in flex, slight three-quarter, flash. Sharpest face detail: eye shape, nose, lips, a short diagonal scar line on his left cheek beside the nose, goatee shape, chest script.

author: Cageside Press
notes: Front-on double-biceps in sunglasses; best physique shot (shoulders, arms, abs, V-taper).

author: Cageside Press
notes: High-res (2280 x 1518) smiling three-quarter at the post-fight presser. Shows teeth, smile lines, cheek marks, goatee from the side.

author: Peter van den Berg / Imagn Images via Reuters (as captioned by Al Jazeera)
notes: Fight action vs Movsar Evloev: Murphy bent low at the waist slipping a punch, hands low. Red shorts, blue corner tape on the gloves.

author: Jasper Wax / Getty Images (as captioned by Al Jazeera)
notes: Walking after the fight: front-on fight-night physique, red shorts with 'MURPHY' on the right leg and a black UFC waistband, blue gloves tape. A fresh cut on the forehead is fight damage, not a permanent feature.
